System 01 · Sales CRM

Plot CRM

The sales team's daily app, Android and web. It manages leads from first call to booking, fills lead forms from a spoken note, scores every telecalling recording with AI, chases pending work with scheduled push reminders, and runs the team's attendance, standups and weekly score board.

Code.gsOAuth from Apps Script, no SDK
const head = enc({ alg: 'RS256', typ: 'JWT' });
const body = enc({ iss: sa.client_email,
  scope: '.../firebase.messaging .../datastore',
  aud: 'https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token',
  iat: now, exp: now + 3600 });
const sig = Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(
  Utilities.computeRsaSha256Signature(
    head + '.' + body, sa.private_key));
// swap the signed JWT for an access token
UrlFetchApp.fetch('https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token', {
  method: 'post', payload: {
  grant_type: 'urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer',
  assertion: head + '.' + body + '.' + sig } });

System 02 · Voice to database

Sarola Field Database

A field-survey app for a new colony launch. The team records villages, local leaders, shops and fairs around Sarola. Instead of typing forms, a field person speaks a Hindi voice note after each meeting, and AI turns it into ready-to-save database entries.

Try live demo paste a note · AI simulated

Hindi voice note to structured data

on event · note recorded
BrowserRecords audio, converts to 16 kHz WAV and splits long notes into chunks
→
Sarvam AISpeech-to-text for Hindi, chunk by chunk with one automatic retry
→
OpenAIReads the transcript and extracts people, shops, events and villages as JSON
→
Review → SheetsPerson checks the entries, then they are saved to Google Sheets via Apps Script

Why it matters: speaking after each meeting is faster than typing long forms on a phone in the field, and nothing is saved until a person approves it.

Clean data, not duplicates

on event · before save
Name matchingHindi spelling variants are normalised (Meena, Mina, Meenaa)
→
Fuzzy matchEdit-distance check links a spoken name to an existing record
→
ValidationMissing required fields and invalid mobile numbers are flagged
→
Offline-firstLast data shows instantly from the phone; fresh data loads behind it
index.htmlchunked transcription
const chunks = splitPcm(await toPcm16k(blob));
let text = '';
for (let i = 0; i < chunks.length; i++) {
  step(`Listening… ${i + 1}/${chunks.length}`);
  const req = { audio: b64(wav(chunks[i])), session, index: i };
  // retry once, so one bad chunk can't drop the whole note
  const r = await api('transcribe', req)
    .catch(() => api('transcribe', req));
  text += (r.text || '') + ' ';
}
await runExtract(text.trim());   // → LLM → entries
index.htmlHindi-aware fuzzy matching
// fold spelling variants: aa→a, ee/y→i, oo→u, w→v
const fold = s => norm(s)
  .replace(/aa/g, 'a').replace(/ee|iy|y/g, 'i')
  .replace(/oo|ou/g, 'u').replace(/w/g, 'v')
  .replace(/(.)\1+/g, '$1');

function findByName(list, name, fuzzy) {
  const k = fold(name);
  let c = list.filter(r => fold(r.Name) === k);
  if (!c.length && fuzzy && k.length >= 5)
    c = list.filter(r => lev(fold(r.Name), k) <= 1);
  return c[0] || null;
}
System 03 · Training and hiring

Akshardham Academy (LMS)

A training portal that doubles as a hiring filter. Candidates and agents sign in with Google, watch each chapter's video and must score 80% on a test to unlock the next chapter. Admins see a selection funnel and pick a shortlist from the people who cleared every chapter.

Learning path

on event · learner signs in
Google sign-inSupabase Auth with Google OAuth (PKCE flow)
→
JoinCandidates and agents self-register; employees pre-added by admin join on first login
→
ChapterVideo, then a test drawn at random from that chapter's question pool
→
Unlock80% or more opens the next chapter; otherwise retake

Exam rules enforced inside the database

on event · test started or submitted
No answer keyQuestions go to the browser without the correct option
→
Fair retryA retake picks questions not used last time first
→
Refresh-safeReloading resumes the same paper instead of drawing a new one
→
Scored in PostgresRow lock stops a double submit; score and pass/fail saved with every answer

Why it matters: the rules live in PostgreSQL functions, not in the page, so a learner cannot unlock a chapter or see answers by editing the browser.

Security and reporting

hourly sync
Row Level SecurityOn all 7 tables: learners read only their own rows, admins everything
→
Token RPCGoogle Sheet pulls data through a token-checked function, never the secret key
→
Apps ScriptWrites Learners and Attempts tabs on a time trigger
→
EmailOwner gets one email listing people who just cleared every chapter
schema.sqlscoring with a row lock
-- double-click or repeat submit is safe
select * into a from attempts
where id = p_attempt and user_id = auth.uid()
  and submitted_at is null for update;
if not found then
  raise exception 'Attempt not found or already submitted';
end if;
...
-- learners get the score only; answers stay hidden

  'pct', v_pct, 'passed', v_pct >= v_pass);
test.mjs41 checks on a real Postgres
// schema.sql runs in in-memory Postgres (PGlite)
const a1 = await start();
assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(a1).includes('correct'));
assert.equal((await start()).attempt_id, a1.attempt_id,
  'refresh resumes same attempt');

// retry draws unused questions first
assert.equal(a2.questions.filter(q =>
  a1.questions.some(x => x.id === q.id)).length, 0);

// learner can't read the question bank (RLS)
assert.equal((await as(L, `select * from questions`)).length, 0);

Visible in the code

How I build

Secrets stay out of code

API keys live in GitHub Secrets and Apps Script PropertiesService, never in the repo.

Public endpoints are authenticated

The notify API verifies a Firebase ID token before it does anything.

Built for real limits

Pushes go out in batches of 500 (the FCM limit) and AI audits are capped per run to stay inside quotas.

Structured AI output

Gemini returns a fixed JSON schema, so results go straight into a spreadsheet.

Safe concurrent writes

LockService in Apps Script and FOR UPDATE row locks in Postgres stop double writes.

Tested against a real database

The LMS ships with 41 automated checks that run its schema in an in-memory Postgres (PGlite).
